items.title: Roche (SWX:ROP) Starts Breast Cancer Trial With Evexta Bio Using Two Drug Candidates
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) has entered a clinical collaboration with Evexta Bio to test a combination of rupitasertib and giredestrant. The partnership focuses on a Phase 1b trial in ER-positive, HER2-negative, ESR1-mutated metastatic breast cancer. The agreement centers on a breast cancer segment with significant unmet medical need. items.title: Roche (SWX:ROP) Wins FDA Clearance And EU Backing For Two Key Treatments
items.summary: Roche Holding (SWX:ROP) received FDA clearance for its cobas BV/CV assay for diagnosing bacterial vaginosis and Candida vaginitis in the United States. The European Medicines Agency’s Committee for Medicinal Products for Human Use recommended approval of Susvimo, a ranibizumab eye implant, for neovascular age related macular degeneration in Europe.
